summary: Kittitas County, WA Goat Peak lookout: D-6 cabin 1928, R-6 tower about 1960; cab sold and moved to the Teanaway Valley in 1969, visible from the road.

facts.design: R-6 flat cabin on a 10-foot treated timber tower (about 1960), replacing a D-6 cupola cabin built in 1928
facts.status_note: Cab sold and moved to the Teanaway Valley in 1969. A 2017 hike report calls the summit a former lookout site with trees around the old site.

access.note: Summit reached on Forest Service land by an unsigned trailhead, per a July 2017 hike report. No current access rules found. The moved cab went to a private buyer in 1969 and is not part of this access.

visit.trail_note: Reached from Easton by Cabin Creek Road and FS Road 41; the trailhead is unsigned, with parking for 3 or 4 cars (2017 hike report)

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register says about 1960 and the Firelookout page says 1960. The 2017 hike report says 1956. The story gives the register's date and reports the hike report's figure.
Only the 2017 hike report mentions an L-4 cabin in the late 1930s. The register and Firelookout do not mention it, so the story presents it as the report's claim.
The register gives 5,100 ft for the lookout site. The hike report gives 4,981 ft for the summit. They are not treated as the same point.
The register and Firelookout say sold to a local resident; the hike report says a local family. Both point to private ownership. No current owner is named in any source.

notes_for_editor: This record is the Kittitas County site near Easton and Teanaway. It is a different structure from the Goat Peak Lookout in Okanogan County (Methow Valley), which is standing, staffed and NHLR-registered as US 357, and whose pages I did not use. The brief's conflict note says the two records share a register number, but the numbers I read differ: this record is FFLOS US 1365, WA 265. The shared element is the name. The current status of the moved cab rests on a 2017 hike report and is not verified since. No source names a current owner. The 4,981 ft summit and the 5,100 ft site figure are both reported and not reconciled. Staffing: only one known lookout (1933) appears, so no facts.staffing is recorded. Reads: 2 websearch.py queries and 6 page reads, one of them a 404 for a guessed Teanaway URL, plus one re-read of the cached WTA page to check a sentence about trees.
